title: Local Dev Test Environment Setup Plan
goal: Create a repo-local Python virtual environment for safe local pytest execution without global installs or runtime config changes.

allowed: Create .venv/ inside the-trading-guy as local-only development environment
Run the already-approved safe pytest subset only
Write and commit workspace audit evidence under ai-labs/projects/trading-agents/
not_allowed: Raw replay log staging or committing
Running the full test suite before separate safe-test audit

commands_planned: git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse origin/main && git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main
explicitly_not_planned: python -m pytest without a file subset
Any command that needs exchange/network credentials
stop_conditions: Source repo is not clean before setup
Source repo HEAD, origin/main, and remote main are not aligned
requirements-dev.txt is missing or contains unexpected broad/runtime dependencies
.venv/ is not ignored or would be tracked
pip install tries to escape .venv or requires sudo/global permissions
Safe test requires .env, network, exchange access, or runtime mutation
Test creates raw replay logs or tracked generated files
Post-test git status shows source/config changes beyond ignored local cache/venv artifacts

expected_outcome.source_repo: clean or only ignored local .venv/cache artifacts
expected_outcome.workspace_commit_message: docs(trading-agents): record local dev test env setup
expected_outcome.push_policy: No push without explicit Julius approval

venv_help.stdout:
usage: python -m venv [-h] [--system-site-packages] [--symlinks | --copies]
                      [--clear] [--upgrade] [--without-pip] [--prompt PROMPT]
                      [--upgrade-deps] [--without-scm-ignore-files]
                      ENV_DIR [ENV_DIR ...]

Creates virtual Python environments in one or more target directories.

positional arguments:
  ENV_DIR               A directory to create the environment in.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --system-site-packages
                        Give the virtual environment access to the system
                        site-packages dir.
  --symlinks            Try to use symlinks rather than copies, when symlinks
                        are not the default for the platform.
  --copies              Try to use copies rather than symlinks, even when
                        symlinks are the default for the platform.
  --clear               Delete the contents of the environment directory if it
                        already exists, before environment creation.
  --upgrade             Upgrade the environment directory to use this version
                        of Python, assuming Python has been upgraded in-place.
  --without-pip         Skips installing or upgrading pip in the virtual
                        environment (pip is bootstrapped by default)
  --prompt PROMPT       Provides an alternative prompt prefix for this
                        environment.
  --upgrade-deps        Upgrade core dependencies (pip) to the latest version
                        in PyPI
  --without-scm-ignore-files
                        Skips adding SCM ignore files to the environment
                        directory (Git is supported by default).

Once an environment has been created, you may wish to activate it, e.g. by
sourcing an activate script in its bin directory.
